svg.title: A 10-year tree, 114540 commits, in blossom: 205-day streak, 7 lanterns for code reviews.
svg.desc: A bonsai grown from the public GitHub history of whale, drawn for 2026-01-20. Season: winter. Weather: calm. Maturity level 13 of 13, in a stone pot. Plaques on the pot rim: commits1k, commits10k, prs100, decade. Every element is recomputable from public history; nothing here is random or purchasable.
